title: Use RPG Maker 2000 Pixel Art in Modern RPG Maker! [RPG Maker MZ & MV]

blocks.source: 現代のツクールでツクール２０００のドット絵を使おう！【RPGツクールMZ&MV】
blocks.translation: Use RPG Maker 2000 Pixel Art in Modern RPG Maker! [RPG Maker MZ & MV]

blocks.source: ＭＺ・ＭＶといった新しいＲＰＧツクール上で、ツクール２０００時代のドット絵を使えるようにするための手順書です。
blocks.translation: This guide explains how to use pixel art from the RPG Maker 2000 era in newer RPG Maker engines such as MZ and MV.

blocks.source: ツクール２０００に限らず、ＳＦＣ時代のようなドット絵を使いたいという人は必見です。
blocks.translation: Anyone who wants to use pixel art reminiscent of the Super Famicom era—not just RPG Maker 2000—should read this.

blocks.source: 目次
blocks.translation: Table of Contents

blocks.source: 初めに
blocks.translation: Introduction

blocks.source: ツクールＸＰ以降、大幅にゲーム画面の解像度が高くなりました。
blocks.translation: Since RPG Maker XP, game screen resolution has increased dramatically.

blocks.source: イラストの利用など表現力の可能性が増した反面、ツクール２０００時代のような低解像度向けのドット絵を使うのが困難となりました。
blocks.translation: While this increased the possibilities for expression, such as using illustrations, it also made it difficult to use low-resolution pixel art like that from the RPG Maker 2000 era.

blocks.source: ＭＶ＆ＭＺに至っては非常に素材の規格も大きくなり、かつてと比較して縦３倍×横３倍＝９倍にも上るようになりました。
blocks.translation: With MV and MZ in particular, asset specifications became much larger, reaching three times the height × three times the width = nine times the size compared to the past.

blocks.source: 同じような手順でドット絵を編集する場合、単純計算で作業量も９倍です。
blocks.translation: When editing pixel art using the same process, the workload is simply nine times greater.

blocks.source: そのため、素材の自作が非常に困難となってしまいました。「デフォルト素材を使う」「デフォルト規格に合わせた外部素材を使う」「ツールに備えたキャラクター生成を使う」といった作者が大半でしょう。
blocks.translation: As a result, creating assets from scratch has become extremely difficult. Most creators probably either use the default assets, use external assets designed to match the default specifications, or use the character generator included with the tools.

blocks.source: ※参考：左（ＭＶ）は実際のゲーム画面ではＦＣ時代のようなチビキャラですが、実体はＳＦＣ水準のドット絵（右）よりもずっと巨大です。
blocks.translation: ※For reference: The character on the left (MV) appears in the actual game screen as a chibi character reminiscent of the Famicom era, but its actual size is much larger than the Super Famicom-quality pixel art on the right.

blocks.source: 「大は小を兼ねる」といった言葉がある通り、ツクール２０００時代の画像素材を２～３倍に拡大すれば使うことも可能です。
blocks.translation: As the saying goes, “bigger can accommodate smaller,” so it is possible to use image assets from the RPG Maker 2000 era by enlarging them two or three times.

blocks.source: ただし、その場合は画像の編集が問題となります。一度、縮小して編集し、また拡大をするというような手間をかける必要があるのです。とても気軽に使えるとは言えない状況でした。
blocks.translation: However, editing the images becomes a problem in that case. You have to go through the trouble of shrinking an image for editing and then enlarging it again. It was hardly a convenient solution.

blocks.source: 結局、ツクールＸＰ以降、ＳＦＣ風ドット絵を愛好するツクーラーの多くはツクール２０００をそのまま使い続けるか、あるいはWOLFエディタなどの外部ツールに流れることになりました。
blocks.translation: Ultimately, since RPG Maker XP, many RPG Maker users who enjoy Super Famicom-style pixel art have either continued using RPG Maker 2000 as-is or moved to external tools such as WOLF Editor.

blocks.source: しかしながら、それでは機能的な制約がどうしても発生します。
blocks.translation: However, that inevitably imposes functional limitations.

blocks.source: ツクール２０００では戦闘やメニュー画面をデフォルトから変更することも困難です。イベントコマンドによってシステムを自作することも可能ですが、相当なプログラミング技能と根気を求められます。
blocks.translation: In RPG Maker 2000, it is difficult to change battles or the menu screen from their defaults. Although it is possible to create your own systems using event commands, doing so requires considerable programming skill and perseverance.

blocks.source: ※元本職ＰＧ（現ニート）兼ツクーラーとしての私見を述べれば、自作戦闘の作成に必要な資質は一般ＩＴ企業のＰＧに求められる水準よりも上です。
blocks.translation: ※In my personal opinion as a former professional programmer (now unemployed) and RPG Maker user, creating a custom battle system requires a level of ability higher than what is expected of programmers at ordinary IT companies.

blocks.source: ※WOLFエディタのほうはよく知りませんが、あちらはあちらで高機能な分だけ敷居が高いです。なんせ僕でも難しいと感じるレベルなので。
blocks.translation: ※I do not know WOLF Editor very well, but it is also difficult to get into because of its extensive functionality. It is at a level that even I find difficult.

blocks.source: その点では、ツクールＭＶ＆ＭＺは非常に優秀な機能を持った上に、それなりの使いやすさも兼ね備えたツールです。
blocks.translation: In that respect, RPG Maker MV and MZ are excellent tools with highly capable features while also offering a reasonable degree of ease of use.

blocks.source: 特にプラグインの仕組みは素晴らしく、大勢のプラグイン作家達の貢献もあってシステムの改変が簡単に行なえます。例えばＳＦＣ時代のＲＰＧのようなシステムを実現したいと考えた場合、必要な労力はツクール２０００時代とは比較にもなりません。
blocks.translation: The plugin system in particular is excellent, and thanks to the contributions of many plugin creators, modifying the system is easy. For example, if you want to create a system like an RPG from the Super Famicom era, the effort required is incomparable to that of the RPG Maker 2000 era.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、目指すはツクール２０００の素材を、ＭＶやＭＺで使用して開発できることです。一度変換するのは仕方ないにしても、以降は編集する度に拡大縮小などの手間をかけないことが理想です。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, the goal is to develop games using RPG Maker 2000 assets in MV or MZ. Although converting them once is unavoidable, ideally you should not have to go through the trouble of enlarging and shrinking them every time you edit them afterward.

blocks.source: また、新規でドット絵を描く際は余計な手間を一切増やしません。本来のサイズでドット絵を描けば、ツクールへと自動的に反映します。エディタ上の表示も崩しません。
blocks.translation: Also, creating new pixel art does not add any extra work. If you draw pixel art at its original size, it will be reflected in RPG Maker automatically. Its display in the editor will not be distorted either.

blocks.source: そんな方法があるのかと思われるかもしれませんが、がんばって用意しました。外部のソフトウェアと作者自身が作ったソフトウェアの組み合わせで行います。
blocks.translation: You may wonder whether such a method exists, but I worked hard to prepare one. It uses a combination of external software and software I created myself.

blocks.source: これを機に、ツクール２０００派の方々も乗り換えを検討してはいかがでしょうか？
blocks.translation: Why not take this opportunity to consider switching, even if you are an RPG Maker 2000 user?

blocks.source: 変換
blocks.translation: Conversion

blocks.source: 素材の種類によって最適な方法が異なります。
blocks.translation: The optimal method varies depending on the type of asset.

blocks.source: 前提として画像はいずれもpng形式とします。
blocks.translation: As a prerequisite, all images are assumed to be in PNG format.

blocks.source: キャラクター
blocks.translation: Characters

blocks.source: ツクール２０００ではキャラクターの向きが上右下左の順で並んでいるのに対して、ＭＶＭＺでは下左右上の順に並んでいます。変換をかけて合わせる必要があります。
blocks.translation: In RPG Maker 2000, character directions are arranged in the order up, right, down, and left, whereas in MV and MZ they are arranged down, left, right, and up. They need to be converted to match.

blocks.source: というわけで、変換プログラムを作りました。
blocks.translation: So I created a conversion program.

blocks.source: https://newrpg.up.seesaa.net/mv/NRP_ChangeChar2KMZ.zip
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.up.seesaa.net/mv/NRP_ChangeChar2KMZ.zip

blocks.source: 使い方は中にある『ChangeChar2KMZ.exe』を起動し、ウィンドウにキャラチップをまとめて放り込むだけです。同じく中にあるconvertフォルダ以下に変換後のファイルが作られます。
blocks.translation: To use it, launch 『ChangeChar2KMZ.exe』 included with it and simply drop your character sheets into the window. The converted files will be created in the convert folder, also included with it.

blocks.source: 拡大率は１倍のままにしてください。拡大処理は別途用意するので、現段階では不要です。
blocks.translation: Please leave the scale at 1×. Enlargement will be handled separately, so it is not needed at this stage.

blocks.source: ※反映した素材は原則編集しないという方は３倍にしてしまっても結構です。その場合、今回の目玉である『拡大＆同期』の手順を取る必要もなくなります。
blocks.translation: ※If you do not intend to edit the assets after importing them, you may enlarge them to 3×. In that case, you will no longer need to perform the “enlarge & synchronize” procedure that is the highlight of this guide.

blocks.source: マップチップ
blocks.translation: Tilesets

blocks.source: 以下のプラグイン（はどはど様）で変換が可能です。手順はリンク先をご覧ください。プラグインパラメータから倍率を指定できますが、同じく１倍でお願いします。
blocks.translation: The following plugin (by Hadahada) can be used for conversion. See the linked page for instructions. You can specify the multiplier in the plugin parameter, but please use 1× here as well.

blocks.source: https://github.com/katai5plate/rpgmv-2000-like-plugins/blob/master/README.md
blocks.translation: https://github.com/katai5plate/rpgmv-2000-like-plugins/blob/master/README.md

blocks.source: ＭＶ用とありますが、ＭＺでも動作することを確認しました。
blocks.translation: Although it is described as being for MV, I have confirmed that it also works in MZ.

blocks.source: むしろ、ＭＶの場合はコアスクリプトのバージョンを合わせないと動かない模様です。『コミュニティ版 community-1.3b』というデフォルトとは異なる環境下が推奨なのでご注意ください。
blocks.translation: In fact, with MV it apparently will not work unless the Core Scripts version is matched. Please note that the recommended environment differs from the default: “Community Version community-1.3b.”

blocks.source: あらかじめコミュニティ版 community-1.3bを適用した空のＭＶ用プロジェクトを用意していますので、よければご活用ください。
blocks.translation: I have prepared an empty MV project with Community Version community-1.3b already applied, so please make use of it if you like.

blocks.source: https://newrpg.up.seesaa.net/mv/ProjectMV_community-13b.zip
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.up.seesaa.net/mv/ProjectMV_community-13b.zip

blocks.source: 説明に書かれている通り、使用にはファイル名の先頭に『2k_』をつける必要があります。数が多い場合は以下のような一括リネームソフトを使うと便利です。
blocks.translation: As stated in the instructions, you need to add 『2k_』 to the beginning of the file names before using them. If you have many files, it is convenient to use a batch renaming tool like the one below.

blocks.source: https://forest.watch.impress.co.jp/library/software/filebababa/
blocks.translation: https://forest.watch.impress.co.jp/library/software/filebababa/

blocks.source: 導入が難しい場合は、上記の元となったｗｅｂ変換器が使えます。ただし、変換後の画像を一つずつダウンロードする必要があるので数が多いと大変です。なぜか、保存時のファイル名も再度手動でつける必要があります。
blocks.translation: If installation is difficult, you can use the web converter on which the above tool was based. However, since you have to download the converted images one at a time, it becomes tedious when there are many. For some reason, you also have to manually enter the file names again when saving.

blocks.source: https://krmbn0576.github.io/rpgmakermv/converter.html
blocks.translation: https://krmbn0576.github.io/rpgmakermv/converter.html

blocks.source: いずれの方法でも、変換した画像はフルカラー形式になってしまいます。
blocks.translation: Regardless of which method you use, the converted images end up in full-color format.

blocks.source: これは元々、ツクール２０００用の素材で使われている２５６色pngとは異なる形式です。余計な色情報を保有しているためドット絵用のペインターからは扱いづらく、また不要にサイズも大きいです。
blocks.translation: This is a different format from the 256-color PNG files originally used for RPG Maker 2000 assets. Because they contain unnecessary color information, they are difficult to handle with pixel-art painting software and are also unnecessarily large.

blocks.source: そのため再変換を行い、２５６色pngに戻します。
blocks.translation: Therefore, convert them again to return them to 256-color PNG format.

blocks.source: 実は先程のキャラチップ変換ツールに同梱されている『optipng.exe』が使えます。
blocks.translation: In fact, you can use 『optipng.exe』, which is included with the character sheet conversion tool mentioned earlier.

blocks.source: これはpngの容量削減ソフトですが、自動で色数に合わせた形式に変換してくれます。
blocks.translation: This software reduces PNG file sizes, but it also automatically converts them to a format matching the number of colors.

blocks.source: exeにファイルをまとめてドロップするだけでＯＫです。
blocks.translation: Simply drop the files onto the EXE all at once.

blocks.source: それ以外（モンスター、顔、背景など）
blocks.translation: Everything Else (Monsters, Faces, Backgrounds, etc.)

blocks.source: 処理不要。以下に従い、ただ拡大するだけです。
blocks.translation: No processing is necessary. Just enlarge them as described below.

blocks.source: 拡大＆同期
blocks.translation: Enlarge & Synchronize

blocks.source: さて、ここからが本番です。
blocks.translation: Now, this is where the real process begins.

blocks.source: 自動拡大プログラムを導入して、ドット絵素材の編集がゲームプロジェクトに自動反映される仕組みを構築します。
blocks.translation: I will introduce an automatic enlargement program to build a system that automatically applies edits to pixel art assets to the game project.

blocks.source: 詳しい説明はリンク先を参照してください。
blocks.translation: Please refer to the linked page for details.

blocks.source: 【改良版】編集した画像を自動的に拡大するソフト
blocks.translation: [Improved Version] Software for Automatically Enlarging Edited Images

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/521119111.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/521119111.html

blocks.source: 【旧版】編集した画像を自動的に拡大するプログラム
blocks.translation: [Old Version] Program for Automatically Enlarging Edited Images

blocks.source: http://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/478208986.html
blocks.translation: http://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/478208986.html

blocks.source: 素材サイト
blocks.translation: Asset Sites

blocks.source: ツクール２０００～２００３のＲＴＰを改変したタイルセットなどを、ＭＶ～ＭＺで使える形式で配布しているサイトです。こちらを使えば、タイルセットの変換などの手間も不要になるのでオススメです！
blocks.translation: This site distributes tilesets and other assets made by modifying the RTP for RPG Maker 2000–2003 in formats that can be used with MV–MZ. I recommend it because using these assets eliminates the need to convert the tilesets and perform other such tasks!

blocks.source: ※規約上、改変元のツクール作品が必要な場合がありますのでご注意ください。
blocks.translation: ※Please note that, depending on the terms of use, you may need the RPG Maker product from which the assets were modified.

blocks.source: がらくた置き場2
blocks.translation: Junk Storage 2

blocks.source: http://garakutamaker.blog.fc2.com
blocks.translation: http://garakutamaker.blog.fc2.com

blocks.source: 画像の縮小
blocks.translation: Reducing Image Size

blocks.source: 「既に３倍にしてしまった素材」や上記のような「既に３倍になっている素材」を取り込みたい場合、画像を1/3に縮小する必要があります。
blocks.translation: If you want to import “assets that have already been enlarged threefold” or “assets that are already three times larger,” as described above, you need to reduce the image to 1/3 of its size.

blocks.source: その場合は以下のソフトで33.34%を指定すれば縮小できます。海外のソフトですが、日本語にも対応しています。
blocks.translation: In that case, you can reduce the image by specifying 33.34% in the software below. It is software from overseas, but it also supports Japanese.

blocks.source: https://www.gigafree.net/tool/resize/XnResize.html
blocks.translation: https://www.gigafree.net/tool/resize/XnResize.html

blocks.source: ……というか、うまく1/3に縮小できるソフトがかなり希少でこれぐらいしか見つかりませんでした。
blocks.translation: Actually, software that can properly reduce an image to 1/3 is quite rare, and this was about the only one I could find.

blocks.source: まず小数点%まで指定できるソフトでないと、計算誤差でドット絵が潰れてしまいます。また、画像に補間をかけたり、フルカラー形式に変換してしまうソフトも多く、その辺りの問題がないことも確認しています。
blocks.translation: First, unless the software lets you specify percentages down to the decimal point, calculation errors will distort the pixel art. I have also confirmed that it does not have the other common issues, such as applying interpolation to the image or converting it to a full-color format.

texts.素材の種類によって最適な方法が異なります。: The optimal method varies depending on the type of asset.
texts.前提として画像はいずれもpng形式とします。: As a prerequisite, all images are assumed to be in PNG format.
texts.ツクール２０００ではキャラクターの向きが上右下左の順で並んでいるのに対して、ＭＶ: In RPG Maker 2000, character directions are arranged in the order up, right, down, and left, whereas in MV and MZ they are arranged down, left, right, and up. They need to be converted to match.
texts.というわけで、変換プログラムを作りました。: So I created a conversion program.
texts.使い方は中にある『ChangeChar2KMZ.exe』を起動し、ウィンドウにキ: To use it, launch 『ChangeChar2KMZ.exe』 included with it and simply drop your character sheets into the window. The converted files will be created in the convert folder, also included with it.
texts.拡大率は１倍のままにしてください。拡大処理は別途用意するので、現段階では不要です: Please leave the scale at 1×. Enlargement will be handled separately, so it is not needed at this stage.
texts.※反映した素材は原則編集しないという方は３倍にしてしまっても結構です。その場合、: ※If you do not intend to edit the assets after importing them, you may enlarge them to 3×. In that case, you will no longer need to perform the “enlarge & synchronize” procedure that is the highlight of this guide.
texts.以下のプラグイン（はどはど様）で変換が可能です。手順はリンク先をご覧ください。プ: The following plugin (by Hadahada) can be used for conversion. See the linked page for instructions. You can specify the multiplier in the plugin parameter, but please use 1× here as well.
texts.ＭＶ用とありますが、ＭＺでも動作することを確認しました。: Although it is described as being for MV, I have confirmed that it also works in MZ.
texts.むしろ、ＭＶの場合はコアスクリプトのバージョンを合わせないと動かない模様です。『: In fact, with MV it apparently will not work unless the Core Scripts version is matched. Please note that the recommended environment differs from the default: “Community Version community-1.3b.”
texts.あらかじめコミュニティ版 community-1.3bを適用した空のＭＶ用プロジ: I have prepared an empty MV project with Community Version community-1.3b already applied, so please make use of it if you like.
texts.説明に書かれている通り、使用にはファイル名の先頭に『2k_』をつける必要がありま: As stated in the instructions, you need to add 『2k_』 to the beginning of the file names before using them. If you have many files, it is convenient to use a batch renaming tool like the one below.
texts.導入が難しい場合は、上記の元となったｗｅｂ変換器が使えます。ただし、変換後の画像: If installation is difficult, you can use the web converter on which the above tool was based. However, since you have to download the converted images one at a time, it becomes tedious when there are many. For some reason, you also have to manually enter the file names again when saving.
texts.いずれの方法でも、変換した画像はフルカラー形式になってしまいます。: Regardless of which method you use, the converted images end up in full-color format.
texts.これは元々、ツクール２０００用の素材で使われている２５６色pngとは異なる形式で: This is a different format from the 256-color PNG files originally used for RPG Maker 2000 assets. Because they contain unnecessary color information, they are difficult to handle with pixel-art painting software and are also unnecessarily large.
texts.そのため再変換を行い、２５６色pngに戻します。: Therefore, convert them again to return them to 256-color PNG format.
texts.実は先程のキャラチップ変換ツールに同梱されている『optipng.exe』が使え: In fact, you can use 『optipng.exe』, which is included with the character sheet conversion tool mentioned earlier.
texts.これはpngの容量削減ソフトですが、自動で色数に合わせた形式に変換してくれます。: This software reduces PNG file sizes, but it also automatically converts them to a format matching the number of colors.
texts.exeにファイルをまとめてドロップするだけでＯＫです。: Simply drop the files onto the EXE all at once.
texts.処理不要。以下に従い、ただ拡大するだけです。: No processing is necessary. Just enlarge them as described below.
texts.さて、ここからが本番です。: Now, this is where the real process begins.
texts.自動拡大プログラムを導入して、ドット絵素材の編集がゲームプロジェクトに自動反映さ: I will introduce an automatic enlargement program to build a system that automatically applies edits to pixel art assets to the game project.
texts.詳しい説明はリンク先を参照してください。: Please refer to the linked page for details.
texts.【改良版】編集した画像を自動的に拡大するソフト: [Improved Version] Software for Automatically Enlarging Edited Images
texts.【旧版】編集した画像を自動的に拡大するプログラム: [Old Version] Program for Automatically Enlarging Edited Images
texts.ツクール２０００～２００３のＲＴＰを改変したタイルセットなどを、ＭＶ～ＭＺで使え: This site distributes tilesets and other assets made by modifying the RTP for RPG Maker 2000–2003 in formats that can be used with MV–MZ. I recommend it because using these assets eliminates the need to convert the tilesets and perform other such tasks!
texts.※規約上、改変元のツクール作品が必要な場合がありますのでご注意ください。: ※Please note that, depending on the terms of use, you may need the RPG Maker product from which the assets were modified.
texts.「既に３倍にしてしまった素材」や上記のような「既に３倍になっている素材」を取り込: If you want to import “assets that have already been enlarged threefold” or “assets that are already three times larger,” as described above, you need to reduce the image to 1/3 of its size.
texts.その場合は以下のソフトで33.34%を指定すれば縮小できます。海外のソフトですが: In that case, you can reduce the image by specifying 33.34% in the software below. It is software from overseas, but it also supports Japanese.
texts.……というか、うまく1/3に縮小できるソフトがかなり希少でこれぐらいしか見つかり: Actually, software that can properly reduce an image to 1/3 is quite rare, and this was about the only one I could find.
texts.まず小数点%まで指定できるソフトでないと、計算誤差でドット絵が潰れてしまいます。: First, unless the software lets you specify percentages down to the decimal point, calculation errors will distort the pixel art. I have also confirmed that it does not have the other common issues, such as applying interpolation to the image or converting it to a full-color format.
